title: Disruption Defined: Carlsberg
description: Welcome to the fourth industrial revolution. After steam, electricity, electronics and IT, the digital age is upon us.  Check out this short video with Judson Althoff, Microsoft’s worldwide commercial business lead, and Mark Dajani, Carlsberg’s chief information officer, who offer a taste of how the company is using AI and machine learning to brew better beer. Learn more: http://msft.social/u733KT  “Disruption Defined: the Road to Digital” is a video series showcasing innovative business leaders who are making digital a competitive advantage for their organizations.  Subscribe to Microsoft on YouTube here: https://aka.ms/SubscribeToYouTube  Follow us on social:  LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/  Twitter: https://twitter.com/Microsoft Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Microsoft/  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/microsoft/    For more about Microsoft, our technology, and our mission, visit https://aka.ms/microsoftstories

asr.full_text: We are here at Carlsberg headquarters in this room where the PH scale was invented So research has always been core to Carlsberg How are you thinking about the role of technology and R&D here at Carlsberg? Carlsberg is a foundation. It's a science and arts foundation. As you experience it and we have a lot of work in our... To us, digital is the foundation that we want to use to help the company grow into the future. And then we think machine learnings and AI that can really make a huge difference in understanding the product itself. The thing that's interesting about beer, it's a natural product, right? It starts with the yeast. So learning through AI how these yeast and how the components behave over time is a big time, it's a big deal and a massive opportunity. You have done so much here at Carlsberg, from better empowering your employees, to even changing how you distribute beer at Bars, maybe just share a little bit about the work with customers a lot of consumer goods people buy in the store they take at home but we have a huge opportunity We have captive consumers at the bar and Konnected Bar is about how we really digitize the bar experience to Konnected, our consumer And since we own a lot of the equipment at the bar it's an opportunity to get a lot of insight that really helps people learn more about beer and you've actually innovated and transformed how you actually distribute the beer itself. Most important to us is the beer itself and the quality of the beer, and we take that very seriously. The new machine that we came in with is a tap that keeps the beer fresh for a much longer period of time. So by the time it makes it to the bar, people are guaranteed fresh beer. As we roll out this new machine, we put the instrumentation on it. So it can get some real analytics and some real data about what's happening in the bar. Maybe share a sort of from a business value to the bar owner what they get out of it? It's about empowering the bar owner. And cleaning up the supply chain to the bar and helping to bar owner market the right product at the right time. And he can do that based on taste profiles of their customers in the bar and helping the bar owner market the right product at the right time." And he can do that based on taste profiles of their customers in the bar. Inventory in the back, how much is left in the keg. And overtime is how do we really link that to big events, football events and other events in the neighborhood and so forth. I think the opportunity is pretty massive. Right. So, better quality, better distribution, more information, serving the bar owner, so better quality through better distribution. More information serving the bar owner. Better connection with the customer. So talk about your journey to the cloud and using cloud services as a way to optimize your operation. Callsburg in 2007 was just a Scandinavian company. And to the acquisitions and the growth the company has really gotten at scale. So we never had it like the single common platform to begin with. So since we started here really now we're migrating most of our infrastructure to the Azure Cloud. But the real challenge though and the real conversation with Microsoft now that we have it in there, how can we really get some serious value out of it? How can we really leverage the Azure platforms and the technology allowed to connect it to really speed up our deployment of new value. Right, so you get your data state in order and your operations in order. Then you can think about how to use your AI and machine learning to actually improve the beer itself. How about any last words of advice you might have for peers of yours in the industry you can think about how to use AI and machine learning to actually improve the beer itself. How about any last words of advice you might have for peers of yours in the industry that are trying to go down this digital path? What kind of words of wisdom might you offer? Be careful of the digital lipstick on the pig. And what I mean by that, just don't take old problems and put more shiny tools on them. So, this is, really to me, the biggest advice. How can you really think differently about the way you operate because of digital not just look at what you do with put digital on top of them super cool well thanks so much Marc I really appreciate thank for anything I appreciate the partnership thank you for your support
